title: VAR2CSA Ectodomain Labeling in Plasmodium falciparum Infected Red Blood Cells
author: Olivia M.S. Carmo
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: Recipes Complete culture media (CCM) Thaw then add the following reagents to 500 mL of RPMI 1640 medium with GlutaMAX and HEPES, store at 4 °C. 25 mL of pooled human sera 25 mL of 5% w/v Albumax II, dissolved in RPMI 1640 medium with GlutaMAX and HEPES 5 mL of media solution (910 mM D-glucose, 0.45 mg/mL gentamicin) 1 mL of 200 mM hypoxanthine

steps.title: Prepare complete culture media
steps.instruction: Thaw RPMI 1640 medium with GlutaMAX and HEPES, then add to 500 mL: 25 mL pooled human serum, 25 mL 5 % w/v Albumax II (dissolved in RPMI), 5 mL media solution (910 mM D‑glucose, 0.45 mg/mL gentamicin), and 1 mL 200 mM hypoxanthine. Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Maintain infected RBC culture
steps.instruction: Culture O⁺ RBCs infected with Plasmodium falciparum at 5 % hematocrit in complete culture media (CCM) at 37 °C in a low‑oxygen malaria mix (1 % O₂, 5 % CO₂, 94 % N₂). Use 250 µL RBCs + 4.75 mL CCM per 35 mm × 10 mm dish to achieve 5 % hematocrit. Keep parasitemia ≤5 % and replace CCM every 24–48 h.

steps.title: Monitor parasitemia by thin smear
steps.instruction: Place 1–2 µL of RBC suspension at one end of a glass slide, smear with a second slide held at 45°, air‑dry, fix in methanol ≥5 s, air‑dry again, then incubate in 10 % Giemsa (diluted in water) for 5 min. Wash with tap water, blot dry, add immersion oil and examine at 100×. Count ≥500 cells to calculate parasitemia.

steps.title: First sorbitol synchronization
steps.instruction: Harvest culture by centrifugation at 528 × g for 5 min (5 acc/1 dec) with slow deceleration. Aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in 5 % w/v D‑sorbitol (volume equal to original culture) to keep 5 % hematocrit. Incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 5–10 min, then centrifuge again at 528 × g for 5 min (5 acc/1 dec), aspirate, and resuspend in CCM to 5 % hematocrit. Return to a fresh dish.

steps.title: Second sorbitol synchronization
steps.instruction: Incubate the culture for 12 h, then repeat the sorbitol synchronization exactly as in the first sync to obtain parasites at ~20–32 h post‑invasion.

steps.title: Harvest and dilute synchronized cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the synchronized culture at 528 × g for 5 min (5 acc/1 dec) with slow deceleration, aspirate media, and resuspend RBCs in 1 % BSA/PBS. Dilute to achieve 3–5 % parasitemia and 2–4 % hematocrit.

steps.title: Load cells into 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 20 µL of the diluted cell suspension into each well (duplicate or triplicate). Add 100 µL of wash buffer (1 % BSA/PBS) to each well (or add before loading). Centrifuge the plate at 528 × g for 90 s (9 acc/9 dec). Aspirate supernatant using a sterile (no‑filter) pipette tip mounted on the aspirator tip, touching the wall of each well. Use a multichannel pipette for all wash steps.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of rabbit polyclonal anti‑VAR2CSA antibody diluted 1:100 in wash buffer (or 1 % BSA/PBS as a no‑primary control) to each well. Incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash after primary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL wash buffer, centrifuge at 528 × g for 90 s (9 acc/9 dec), aspirate supernatant. Then add another 100 µL wash buffer, centrifuge, and aspirate.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Resuspend each well with 10 µL mouse anti‑rabbit IgG (γ‑chain specific) diluted 1:100 in wash buffer. Incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash after secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Repeat the two‑wash procedure described in “Wash after primary antibody”.

steps.title: Tertiary fluorophore incubation
steps.instruction: Add 10–20 µL goat anti‑mouse IgG (H+L) conjugated to a fluorophore (1:100) in wash buffer. Use Alexa Fluor 488 for non‑GFP lines or Alexa Fluor 647 for GFP‑expressing lines. Incubate 30 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash after tertiary antibody
steps.instruction: Repeat the two‑wash procedure described earlier.

steps.title: DNA stain (Hoechst) incubation
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Hoechst 33342 diluted 1:2000 in wash buffer to each well. Incubate 30 min at 37 °C. Wash twice using the standard wash steps, then wash once with 100 µL PBS. Resuspend cells in 200 µL PBS to obtain a final hematocrit of 0.2–0.4 %. Proceed to flow cytometry.

steps.title: Nucleic acid stain (SYTO‑61) incubation
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL SYTO‑61 (5 µM in PBS) to each well. Incubate 15 min at room temperature. Add 180 µL PBS to dilute to 0.02 % hematocrit and incubate an additional 30 min at room temperature before measurement.

steps.title: Flow cytometry acquisition
steps.instruction: Set the high‑throughput sampler (HTS) to: flow rate 0.5 µL/s, sample volume 20 µL, mixing volume 100 µL, mixing speed 200 µL/s, 4 mixes, wash volume 800 µL. Collect 50 000 events per well and export as FCS‑3 files. Gating: (1) SSC‑H vs FSC‑A to select total RBCs; (2) FSC‑H vs FSC‑W to select singlets; (3) Pacific blue (DNA) vs FITC (tertiary antibody) to define quadrants (Q4 uninfected, Q1 infected‑no surface, Q2 infected‑surface). Adjust Pacific blue and FITC voltages so the quadrant divide is around 10³. Apply the same settings to all wells.

steps.title: Instrument cleanup
steps.instruction: Flush the flow cytometer sequentially with ≥400 µL 0.1 % w/v Triton X‑100, then ≥400 µL 1 % sodium hypochlorite, and finally ≥800 µL ultra‑pure water.

description: Materials and reagents Storage notes: All primary antibodies are stored at -20 °C. Secondary antibodies and DNA stains are stored at 4 °C unless otherwise noted.
